clocks.note: All Sept 25 offsets are on the dispatch clock. Observer (Slot Watch) offsets were shifted by dispatch − observer offset.

sep23.note: Sept 23 reads are runner SPECIAL_AVAILABILITY_SAMPLE events (PC wall clock; the PC offset that morning was not recorded, typically tens of ms).

lanes.note: Successful off-peak checkouts only. Proofless: Playwright request event → response (runner network duration). Proof-based: slot proofs ready → response logged (includes a few ms of local work before the POST).

commitSummary.note: hold_expires_at − 10 min is the provider-side hold creation time. PC-clock positions shift by the unknown PC offset of each test day (recorded offsets ranged from ~5 ms to ~1 s); spreads and orders within a run are offset free.
